text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Why? All the sufficient conditions were met.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Was it where I made my move? Did I mess up the pace, or fail to analyze the winner properly? Environmental factors—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, I will analyze that thoroughly later.
For now, I must recalculate.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Air Shakur
already left.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh! They didn't look over here
at all, did they...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did losing put her in a bad mood?
She really is as difficult as the rumors say...

Losing meant it didn't follow Parcae's
"best route."
She likely wants to check her current status right away.

I hurriedly chased after Air Shakur...
She was breathing quietly with her shoulders rising and falling, staring at the computer screen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What the heck influenced it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The answer changed even further, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That 7 cm... had shrunk down to 3 cm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I had the calculations rerun twice before you arrived,
but the answer remained unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what caused it,
but the numbers have definitely changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just 3 cm... only 3 cm...
If this reaches zero—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whew... Wait, hold on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even so, all it did was close the gap in the numbers for the "optimal route."
If I can't bring it down to zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
it is a path that "ends."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "First, I gotta bring it up to the theoretical limit where I only lose by 7 cm, then re-examine the factors to bring that difference to zero..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You head on back first.

Before I could answer, Air Shakur had already left.
She probably wanted to sort things out somewhere she could focus. As I thought that—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? Guess she really is
like that normally too... pretty selfish, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't she feel frustrated about losing?
I just can't bring myself to cheer for someone like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...All the voices will vanish
as long as that 7cm gap changes.

Air Shakur will definitely deliver results
at the Nippon Derby. When that happens,
the perceptions around her should change too.
choice_data_list: (More than anything, Air Shakur's strength is the real deal.)

text_block_list.text:
If we keep stacking victories in major races from here on,
her true charm is sure to get through—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really startin' to change?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I won't have that damn nightmare anymore either...
It's gonna end. It'll end, and begin anew...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Only 3 centimeters left.
Once that hits zero, I'll...)
――But... what if that three centimeters never shrinks any further?

"If destiny remains unchanged,
and we were merely toyed with by false hope..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, no... no.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Think, squeeze every drop out, scrape it all together.
I still can't see the tail of the Goddess of Victory. But—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Even if I gotta take it by force, I'm makin' it mine...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait...
Japanese Derby!"
